headline: GLP-1 therapy has a [[muscle problem.]]
body: Why the next phase of obesity care belongs in the gym.

headline: Up to [[39%]] of weight lost can be lean mass.
body: In the STEP 1 body composition substudy, lean mass made up as much as 39% of total weight lost on GLP-1 therapy alone.
source: Wilding et al., N Engl J Med 2021

headline: Stopping brings [[most of it back.]]
body: One year after treatment ended in the STEP 1 extension, participants had regained two-thirds of the weight they lost.
source: Wilding et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022

headline: Medication plus exercise [[beats either alone.]]
body: After an initial diet, GLP-1 therapy combined with structured exercise cut body-fat percentage about twice as much as either treatment on its own over one year.
source: Lundgren et al., N Engl J Med 2021

headline: The open question [[is muscle.]]
body: LEAN-PREP, a randomised trial at Dasman Diabetes Institute, is testing resistance exercise and protein in 232 adults starting GLP-1 therapy.
